target.statement: Our model achieves BLEU F1 of 0.297 on DailyDialog, outperforming DialogWAE-GMP (0.273) and other baselines.

compute.basis: Estimate based on typical training time for a VAE-based dialogue model on DailyDialog (~10k dialogues) with 3 curriculum phases, each ~10 epochs, on CPU; includes data download, preprocessing, BM25 exemplar retrieval, and evaluation.

blockers: Complex model with three-phase curriculum training and WGAN components
Requires implementing BM25 retrieval for exemplars
Evaluation requires sampling 10 responses per context and computing multiple metrics
title: Towards Multimodal Response Generation with Exemplar Augmentation and Curriculum Optimization
